messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- INC-2025-023 was an incident affecting the indexer on 2025-10-13. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The INC-2025-023 review on 2025-10-16 decided that reindex jobs will page on failure. [decision; valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- A silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- On 2025-10-22, Team Dune agreed that the webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review. [decision; valid 2025-10-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-22]
- On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [decision; valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
- On 2025-12-17, Team Dune's standup decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write. [decision; valid 2025-12-17 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-17]
- INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- As of the 2025-05-19 rotation day, the policy is to page Diego for anything Cinder-related. [decision; valid 2025-05-19 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-19]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-29, the policy is to page Yuki for anything Cinder-related. [decision; valid 2025-04-29 to 2025-05-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-29]
- INC-2025-017 was an incident affecting the auth gateway on 2025-07-27. [valid 2025-08-01 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- Dashboards and alerts for the catalog service are being repointed as of 2025-06-16. [valid 2025-06-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-16-catalog]
- As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to the Ember team. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to Team Boreal. [valid 2025-11-07 to 2025-11-17; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-11-07; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- INC-2025-017 was caused by an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-08-01 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- The INC-2026-003 review on 2026-01-22 decided that the webhooks service will require an idempotency key on every delivery because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one. [decision; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- On the 2025-12-15 rotation day, Tomasz Nowak handed the Team Dune pager to Farah. [valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-15]
- The root cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- On 2026-03-10, Team Dune observed that after Tuesday's deploy, the reporting service's p99 latency doubled. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]

Question: On what date was the review of INC-2025-023 written?

message.reasoning: The memory says: "INC-2025-023 review on 2025-10-16 decided that reindex jobs will page on failure." The review was on 2025-10-16. Answer: 2025-10-16.
